members.description:
Commit edit with validation.

The edit ENDS synchronously, here — never after an `await`: a move (Tab, Enter, a click on
another cell) commits and then starts the next edit at once, so an edit-state change that waited
for an async `validateCallback` would end the NEXT cell's edit (and leave the old editor open to a
second commit / a cancel). The validation result is applied when it arrives:
- sync `validateCallback` (or none) and no commit pending → applied right here, as before;
- a promise, or earlier commits still pending → the typed value goes into the draft now (the cell
  shows it), the result (draft value / invalid mark / `validation-error` / `row-change`) is applied
  when it arrives, in COMMIT ORDER (a later commit waits for the earlier ones), then the cell is
  re-rendered (`_onCommitApplied`). The returned promise settles after the apply.

members.name: isCellEditable
members.description:
Check if a column's cells can be edited.
`row` is required to evaluate function-form predicates; pass it for per-row checks,
omit it for static column-level checks (e.g. building toolbar UI). When omitted and a
predicate exists, conservatively returns true so the column isn't hidden.

Resolution order:
  0. tree column in tree mode → not editable (the tree column displays hierarchy, not data)
  1. column.isEditable === false → not editable (hard veto)
  2. column.isEditable === function with row → must return true to continue
  3. grid.isRowEditable with row → must pass to continue
  4. column.isEditable === true → editable (overrides grid-level)
  5. else → defer to grid-level isEditingEnabled

range shortcuts. Routes the shortcut context to either the row-selection
shape or the cell-range shape based on which selection is active.

allowed it. Returns `true` when it was applied synchronously, `false` when it
was cancelled, ignored (another change pending) or deferred (async hook — it
applies + renders itself when the hook resolves).

declarations.name: handlePaginationClick
declarations.description:
Handle pagination button click (first, prev, next, last) — through
`beforePageChangeCallback` (trigger 'page'). Returns true if the page changed
synchronously (caller should re-render); an async hook applies + renders itself.

declarations.name: handlePageSizeChange
declarations.description:
Handle page size select change — through `beforePageChangeCallback` (trigger
'page-size', toPage 1). Returns true if the page size changed synchronously.

declarations.name: attachPaginationListeners
declarations.description:
Attach pagination click + page-size change listeners to the `.wg` container.

Why the container (not `.wg__pagination`): when `isPagingEnabled` toggles or the
pagination region re-renders, its DOM is replaced via innerHTML and any
listener attached directly to the pagination element is lost. Delegating
from the container survives surgical re-renders.

row creation). Single-cell takes the direct path: column.getPasteValueCallback
converts, then grid.commitEdit. Both paths render after.

setup) we add `.wg__tree-chevron--expanded` and CSS rotates the glyph 90°.

render (cell.ts), so both paths keep the chevron after focus/edit transitions.

declarations.name: virtualRowScrollTop
declarations.description:
Virtual scroll: the `.wg` scrollTop that shows the displayed row `rowIndex` per `block`
(core `getScrollTopForBox`, SPEC §12.15 — the row may not be rendered), or `null` when
nothing has to move. The row's box is in the container's content coordinates (below the
header: rows start at the tbody's top); the sticky header is the top inset.

declarations.name: prepareRowReveal
declarations.description:
Virtual scroll, a keyboard move to the displayed row `rowIndex`: make the row RENDERED and in
view NOW, synchronously — before the caller focuses its cell. A row outside the rendered
window has no element to focus or reveal; waiting for the scroll event to render it lost the
focus (and a held key, whose next keydown came before that render, moved from a stale cell).

The window for the target scrollTop (core `getScrollTopForBox()` with the gated `block`) is
rendered first, then the container scrolls with the programmatic flag set, so the scroll
handler doesn't render again. `beforeScrollCallback` returning `false` keeps the scroll
position; the current window is then stretched to hold the row (it stays focusable).
No-op (`undefined`) outside virtual scroll or when the row is already fully in view.

declarations.name: finishCellReveal
declarations.description:
The second half of a keyboard reveal, after the cell got focus: `undefined` (nothing was
prepared) → the usual gated `revealElement()`; options → only the horizontal axis is left
(the row is in view vertically — `block: 'nearest'` keeps it); `null` → skipped.

Virtual scroll: a scroll made here (a row a pixel short of fully visible, the horizontal axis)
gets its window rendered NOW, not by the scroll event a frame later — that late swap re-rendered
the body under the next key (an edit started right after the move lost its editor).

declarations.name: syncVirtualWindow
declarations.description:
Virtual scroll: render the window for the container's CURRENT scrollTop now, when it differs
from the rendered one (what the scroll handler would do on the next frame). No-op otherwise.

declarations.name: fieldAt
declarations.description: The field of the column at `colIndex` (an index into `columns`), or `null`.

declarations.name: scrollRowIntoView
declarations.description:
Scroll the displayed row `rowIndex` into view — `scrollToRow()` and the go-to-row dialog.
Resolves `true` once it is in view (after a frame), `false` when the index is out of range,
the row isn't rendered (not built yet) or `beforeScrollCallback` skipped it. With virtual
scroll it pre-renders the target range once, then scrolls by index (a flag stops the scroll
handler from rendering again).

members.name: #applyConfig

members.name: isNavigateMode

members.name: getRowDraft
members.description: The draft (unsaved copy) of the row at this display index, or `undefined`.

members.name: hasRowDraft

members.name: getDraftRowIndices

members.name: getDrafts

members.name: discardDraft

members.name: discardAllDrafts

members.name: isCellInvalid

members.name: getCellValidationError

members.name: getRowId

members.name: getRowIndex

members.name: isRowLocked

members.name: getRowLockInfo

members.name: clearExternalLocks

members.name: canEditCell

members.name: setColumnWidth

members.name: setColumnWidths

members.name: focusCell
members.description:

members.name: scheduleSummaryRefresh

members.name: scrollToRow

screen too). Resolves `true` once it is in view (after a frame), `false` when the index is

event detail).

members.name: isFilteringEnabled

members.name: filterMode

- `server` — the grid does not filter — handle `filter-change` (`{ filters }`) and replace `items`

members.name: isPagingEnabled
members.description: Split the rows into pages and show the pager. Default: `false`.

members.name: pageSize
members.description: Rows per page (at least 1). Default: `10`.

members.name: paginationMode
members.description:

- `client` — the grid slices `items` into pages
- `server` — `items` already is the current page — handle `data-request` and set `totalItems`

members.name: isPaginationShown
members.description:
When the pager is shown. Default: `true`.

- `true` — always
- `false` — never
- `auto` — hidden while there is at most one page

members.name: paginationPosition
members.description:
Where the pager sits: one area or several `|`-separated ones (`top-right|bottom-right`); any other value is refused. Default: `bottom-center`.

- `top-left` — above the table, left
- `top-center` — above the table, centered
- `top-right` — above the table, right
- `bottom-left` — below the table, left
- `bottom-center` — below the table, centered
- `bottom-right` — below the table, right

members.name: paginationLayout
members.description:
The pager parts in order, `|`-separated (`first|previous|page-info|next|last`). Default: `page-size|previous|page-info|next`.

- `first` — go to the first page
- `previous` — go one page back
- `page-info` — the "page X of Y" text
- `next` — go one page forward
- `last` — go to the last page
- `page-size` — the rows-per-page selector (options from `pageSizes`)

members.name: isStriped
members.description: Alternate the row background colors. Default: `true`.

members.name: isHoverable
members.description: Highlight the row under the pointer. Default: `true`.

members.name: isTableBorderOnly
members.description: Draw the border around the table only, not around the pager / summary areas. Default: `false`.

members.name: isScrollable
members.description: Make the grid its own scroll container, capped at `scrollMaxHeight`. Default: `false`.

members.name: scrollMaxHeight
members.description: Max height of the scroll container while `isScrollable` is on — a CSS length; a number means pixels (`240` → `240px`); an invalid length is refused. Default: `100vh`.

members.name: isEditingEnabled
members.description: Allow editing cells (columns opt in with `isEditable`). Default: `false`.

members.name: editTrigger
members.description:
How editing a cell starts (a column’s own `editTrigger` wins). Default: `dblclick`.

- `click` — a single click opens the editor
- `dblclick` — a double click opens the editor
- `button` — an edit button in editable cells (on hover and in the focused cell); F2 / Enter too
- `always` — every editable cell is always an editor

members.name: editButtonIcon
members.description: Content of the edit button — an HTML string, e.g. ``. Shown in editable cells with `editTrigger: 'button'` (or `column.isEditButtonShown`); its accessible name is `labels.editCell`. Default: `✎`.

members.name: editStartSelection
members.description:
Where the caret goes when an editor opens. Default: `mouse-position`.

- `mouse-position` — at the clicked character
- `select-all` — the whole value selected
- `cursor-at-start` — caret before the first character
- `cursor-at-end` — caret after the last character

members.name: shouldCommitOnClickAway
members.description: Clicking another cell while editing commits the value (through `beforeCommitCallback` / `validateCallback`); `false` discards it. Default: `true`.

members.name: preset
members.description:
Sets editing / selection defaults in one go; inputs set explicitly in the same batch win. Default: `excel`.

- `read-only` — no editing, a click selects cells; also sets `isReadonly`
- `excel` — editing on, `editTrigger: navigate`, a drag selects a cell range
- `input-matrix` — every cell is always an editor (`editTrigger: always`), Shift+click selects cells, dropdowns open on focus

members.name: isReadonly
members.description: Values cannot change (no edit / paste / fill / row add-delete-move); the grid stays focusable, selectable and copyable. Attribute `readonly` — presence decides (`readonly="false"` is still read-only), reflects. Default: `false`.

members.name: isDisabled
members.description: No interaction at all (not focusable, dimmed). Attribute `disabled` — presence decides, reflects. Default: `false`.

members.name: cellSelectionMode
members.description:
How a cell range is selected. In every mode but `none`, Shift+Arrow grows / shrinks the range from the focused cell. Default: `click`.

- `none` — no cell-range selection
- `click` — a drag selects; Shift+click extends from the focused cell
- `shift` — Shift+click twice or Shift+drag selects

members.name: dropdownToggleVisibility
members.description:
When the ▼ toggle of a dropdown cell is shown (a column’s own setting wins). Default: `always`.

- `always` — in every dropdown cell
- `on-focus` — only in the focused cell

members.name: shouldOpenDropdownOnFocus
members.description: Open a dropdown editor as soon as its cell gets focus. Default: `true`.

members.name: shouldOpenDropdownOnEnter
members.description: Enter on a dropdown cell opens the dropdown (`true`) or moves to the next row (`false`); a column’s own setting wins. Default: `false`.

members.name: isCheckboxAlwaysEditable
members.description: Checkbox cells toggle with one click, even in `navigate` mode. Default: `false`.

members.name: isRowNumbersShown
members.description: Show the row-number column (a click / Ctrl / Shift / drag on it selects rows). Default: `false`.

members.name: isDirtyIndicatorShown
members.description: Mark cells with unsaved changes (drafts). Default: `true`.

members.name: isStickyRowNumbers
members.description: Keep the row-number column in place while scrolling horizontally. Default: `false`.

members.name: frozenColumnCount
members.description: Freeze the first N columns while scrolling horizontally (counted after the reorder by `column.isFrozen`). Default: `0`.

members.name: isRowToolbarShown
members.description: Show the row toolbar (`rowToolbar` entries) next to the hovered / focused row. Default: `false`.

members.name: toolbarVerticalAlign
members.description:
Vertical alignment of the row toolbar in the `left` / `right` positions. Default: `bottom`.

- `top` — aligned to the row top (extends upwards)
- `center` — centered on the row
- `bottom` — aligned to the row bottom (extends downwards)

members.name: toolbarHorizontalAlign
members.description:
Horizontal alignment of the row toolbar in the `top` position. Default: `center`.

- `start` — at the start of the row / `toolbarColumn`
- `center` — centered
- `end` — at the end
- `cursor` — at the pointer position

members.name: toolbarTrigger
members.description:
How the row toolbar opens. Default: `hover`.

- `hover` — on row hover
- `click` — on a click in the row
- `button` — from a trigger button in the row

members.name: toolbarPosition
members.description:
Preferred position of the row toolbar. Default: `auto`.

- `auto` — the side with room
- `left` — left of the row
- `right` — right of the row
- `top` — above the row (see `toolbarHorizontalAlign`, `toolbarColumn`)
- `inline` — inside the row

members.name: shouldToolbarFollowCursor
members.description: The row toolbar follows the pointer horizontally. Default: `false`.

members.name: cellToolbarOffset
members.description: Horizontal offset of the cell toolbar: a number 0–1 is a fraction of the cell width, a string any CSS length (`2rem`). Default: `0.2`.

members.name: contextMenuXOffset
members.description: Horizontal offset (px) of the context menu from the click point. Default: `8`.

members.name: contextMenuYOffset
members.description: Vertical offset (px) of the context menu from the click point. Default: `0`.

members.name: isShortcutsHelpShown
members.description: Show the keyboard-shortcuts help icon. Default: `false`.

members.name: shortcutsHelpPosition
members.description:
Corner of the keyboard-shortcuts help icon. Default: `top-right`.

- `top-right` — top right corner
- `top-left` — top left corner

members.name: columnMinWidth
members.description: Default `min-width` of every column without its own `minWidth` — a CSS length; a number means pixels. Unset = none.

members.name: isColumnReorderAllowed
members.description: Let the user drag headers to reorder columns. Default: `false`.

members.name: sortMode
members.description:
Header-click sorting. Default: `none`.

- `none` — sorting off
- `single` — one sorted column at a time
- `multiple` — several sorted columns (Ctrl+click adds a column)

members.name: storageKey
members.description: Key of the persisted column state (widths / order the user arranged; core SPEC §12.17). Unset / empty = off; set = localStorage `km-state:web-grid:<key>`, or `loadStateCallback` / `saveStateCallback`.

members.name: shouldPersistColumnWidths
members.description: Persist the column widths the user resized to (needs `storage-key`).

members.name: shouldPersistColumnOrder
members.description: Persist the column order the user dragged to (needs `storage-key`).

members.name: loadStateCallback
members.description: Persisted column state source: `(ctx) => GridPersistenceState | null | Promise<…>`, `ctx`: `{ key }` + context. Set both callbacks; either one alone switches localStorage off.

members.name: saveStateCallback
members.description: Persisted column state sink: `ctx`: `{ key, state }` + context, `state` = the WHOLE `GridPersistenceState` (`{ columnWidths?, columnOrder? }`). Set both callbacks; either one alone switches localStorage off.

members.name: summaryPosition
members.description:
Where the summary bar (`renderSummaryCallback`) sits: one area or several `|`-separated ones, like `paginationPosition`. Unset = no summary.

- `top-left` — above the table, left
- `top-center` — above the table, centered
- `top-right` — above the table, right
- `bottom-left` — below the table, left
- `bottom-center` — below the table, centered
- `bottom-right` — below the table, right

members.name: isSummaryInline
members.description: The summary shares one line with the pager when both sit in the same area. Default: `true`.

members.name: isVirtualScrollEnabled
members.description: Render only the visible rows (give the grid a capped height). Default: `false`.

members.name: virtualScrollThreshold
members.description: Row count from which the engine's automatic virtual scroll turns on. Default: `100`.

members.name: virtualScrollItemHeight
members.description: Fixed row height (px) virtual scroll computes with. Default: `38`.

members.name: virtualScrollOverscan
members.description: Extra rows rendered above / below the viewport in virtual scroll. Default: `10`.

members.name: isInfiniteScrollEnabled
members.description: Ask for more rows (`data-request`, `trigger: load-more`) when scrolled near the end, until `hasMoreItems` is `false`. Default: `false`.

members.name: infiniteScrollThreshold
members.description: Distance (px) from the bottom that triggers the next infinite-scroll load. Default: `100`.

members.name: isNewRowEnabled
members.description: Experimental: an always-present empty row for entering a new record. Default: `false`.

members.name: newRowPosition
members.description:
Experimental: where the empty new row sits. Default: `bottom`.

- `top` — above the data rows
- `bottom` — below the data rows

members.name: newRowIndicator
members.description: Experimental: text shown in the row-number cell of the empty new row. Default: `+`.

members.name: isTreeDataSorted
members.description: Tree data: trust the order of `items` (the grid never re-sorts — pair with `data-request` for sort changes); `false` sorts siblings depth-first. Default: `false`.

members.name: treeDoubleClickBehavior
members.description:
What a double-click on a tree-column cell does. Default: `none`.

- `none` — nothing tree-specific (editing may start)
- `toggle` — expands / collapses the row

members.name: treeExpandedGlyph
members.description: HTML / text of the chevron of an expanded tree row. Equal to `treeCollapsedGlyph` → CSS rotates the glyph; different → the glyph is swapped. Default: `▶`.

members.name: treeCollapsedGlyph
members.description: HTML / text of the chevron of a collapsed tree row. Default: `▶`.

members.name: shouldCopyWithHeaders
members.description: Copying a cell range also copies the column headers. Default: `false`.

members.name: pasteMode
members.description:
How a multi-cell paste treats cells that are not editable. Default: `skip-non-editable`.

- `skip-non-editable` — skips them, pastes the rest
- `all-columns` — pastes into them anyway
- `editable-only` — refuses them (reported as skipped and invalid)

members.name: shouldValidateOnPaste
members.description: Run `validateCallback` on every pasted cell. Default: `true`.

members.name: fillDirection
members.description:
Fill-handle drag direction for the whole grid; a column’s own `fillDirection` wins. Default: `vertical`.

- `vertical` — fills the source column only
- `all` — also fills across columns

members.name: labels
members.description: UI strings (i18n) — a partial object (JSON attribute `labels`) merged per key over the English defaults: `noData`, `noResults`, `loading`, pager / go-to-row / menu texts, …. Reads back what was assigned.

members.name: customStyles
members.description: CSS injected into the grid's shadow root (after the page-wide `window.components['web-grid'].customStyles`); an `@import`ed font is also linked in the document head.

members.name: getCustomStylesCallback
members.description: Computes the instance CSS from the grid context; wins over `customStyles`.

members.name: renderLoadingCallback
members.description: Custom render for the grid's loading states (`ctx.context`: 'row' | 'search'); fills `ctx.containerElement`, may return a cleanup.

members.name: beforeScrollCallback
members.description: Runs before the grid scrolls a cell / row into view on its own (`ctx.source`: keyboard | scroll-to-row | go-to-row); `false` skips, a partial `options` replaces the defaults. Synchronous.

members.name: tooltipShowDelay
members.description: Delay (ms) before a cell tooltip shows. Default: `200`.

members.name: tooltipHideDelay
members.description: Delay (ms) before a cell tooltip hides. Default: `100`.

members.name: overlayGroup
members.description: Scope the "one overlay open at a time" coordination to a named group. Overlays (the cell dropdown, the row toolbar with a click / button trigger, multiselects, datepickers, external popovers) sharing a group dismiss each other when one opens; different groups are independent. Unset = the default (ungrouped) group.

members.name: shouldDefer
members.description: Hold the first build (core, SPEC §6.3): while set when the element first connects, nothing is built and every input, callback and listener assigned meanwhile accumulates; `release()` (or removing the attribute) then builds once. Latched after the first build.

members.name: themeSource
members.description: Where this element reads its theme from instead of the page (core, SPEC §12.10): a CSS selector (nearest matching ancestor, else the first match), `'closest'` (the nearest ancestor carrying a theme signal), or (property only) an `Element`. Unset = the page.

members.name: motion
members.description: Motion level (core, SPEC §12.16): `auto` (default — inherit: the nearest `data-motion` ancestor (a section), else the page level `window.components.motion` / `<html data-motion>`; closest wins), `none` (no transitions, instant scrolling), `snappy` (short) or `smooth` (longer). Sets the shared `--base-duration-*` / `--base-scroll-behavior` tokens on the element through `data-motion`; the OS reduced-motion setting always wins.

members.name: responsive
members.description: Instance responsive rules (core, SPEC §6.7): partial configs on two axes — `device` (keyed by device class `mobile` / `tablet` / `desktop`; a mouse device is `desktop` at any width) and `breakpoint` (keyed by the window-width bucket); the breakpoint entry applies first, the device entry over it (device wins). An object or a JSON attribute, e.g. `{"device":{"tablet":{"presentation":"modal"}},"breakpoint":{"mobile":{…}}}`. Beats page rules (`window.components.responsive*`) and values set on the element; never reflects. An entry of `null` ignores the page rules while it matches.

members.name: responsiveCallback
members.description: Instance computed responsive rule (core, SPEC §6.7): `(ctx) => partial config | null | undefined`, ctx `{ env, deviceClass, breakpoint, element, component, config }` (`config` = base). Runs after `responsive` (wins key by key); re-runs on environment flips, throttled viewport-width changes, rule and config changes. `null` ignores every page rule.

members.name: isReady
members.description: The first build is live (core, SPEC §6.3) — the `ready` event has fired.

members.name: whenReady
members.description: Resolves once the first build is live (also settles when the element is destroyed first). Never rejects.

members.name: release
members.description: Build an element held by `defer` (SPEC §6.3), with everything assigned meanwhile.

members.name: setAttributes
members.description: Apply many inputs (by configKey or attribute name) as ONE rebuild / update. Returns the values it refused (each also fires `input-rejected`).

members.name: batch
members.description: Run `fn` and coalesce every input change it makes into one rebuild / update.

members.name: flush
members.description: Apply pending input writes synchronously, now (SPEC §12.7).

members.name: whenSettled
members.description: Resolves once every staged input change has been applied (SPEC §12.7).

members.name: destroy
members.description: Final teardown (SPEC §6.5): the element is inert afterwards; idempotent.

members.name: isDestroyed
members.description: `destroy()` ran.

members.name: enableLogging
members.description: Set this element's own log level (default `debug`): it logs that level and above, whatever its component type or the page is set to.

members.name: disableLogging
members.description: Silence this element (its own level = `silent`).

members.name: resetLogging
members.description: Clear this element's own log level: it follows its component type / the page again.

members.name: form
members.description: The owning form (form-associated components).

members.name: validity
members.description: Form validity (SPEC §6.6).

members.name: validationMessage
members.description: Form validation message (SPEC §6.6).

members.name: willValidate
members.description: Whether the element takes part in form validation.

members.name: checkValidity
members.description: Form validity check (SPEC §6.6).

members.name: reportValidity
members.description: Form validity check that reports to the user (SPEC §6.6).

attributes.description: Clicking another cell while editing commits the value (through `beforeCommitCallback` / `validateCallback`); `false` discards it. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: preset
attributes.description:
Sets editing / selection defaults in one go; inputs set explicitly in the same batch win. Default: `excel`.

- `read-only` — no editing, a click selects cells; also sets `isReadonly`
- `excel` — editing on, `editTrigger: navigate`, a drag selects a cell range
- `input-matrix` — every cell is always an editor (`editTrigger: always`), Shift+click selects cells, dropdowns open on focus

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Values cannot change (no edit / paste / fill / row add-delete-move); the grid stays focusable, selectable and copyable. Attribute `readonly` — presence decides (`readonly="false"` is still read-only), reflects. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: No interaction at all (not focusable, dimmed). Attribute `disabled` — presence decides, reflects. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: cell-selection-mode
attributes.description:
How a cell range is selected. In every mode but `none`, Shift+Arrow grows / shrinks the range from the focused cell. Default: `click`.

- `none` — no cell-range selection
- `click` — a drag selects; Shift+click extends from the focused cell
- `shift` — Shift+click twice or Shift+drag selects

attributes.name: dropdown-toggle-visibility
attributes.description:
When the ▼ toggle of a dropdown cell is shown (a column’s own setting wins). Default: `always`.

- `always` — in every dropdown cell
- `on-focus` — only in the focused cell

attributes.name: open-dropdown-on-focus
attributes.description: Open a dropdown editor as soon as its cell gets focus. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: open-dropdown-on-enter
attributes.description: Enter on a dropdown cell opens the dropdown (`true`) or moves to the next row (`false`); a column’s own setting wins. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: checkbox-always-editable
attributes.description: Checkbox cells toggle with one click, even in `navigate` mode. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: show-row-numbers
attributes.description: Show the row-number column (a click / Ctrl / Shift / drag on it selects rows). Default: `false`.

attributes.name: show-dirty-indicator
attributes.description: Mark cells with unsaved changes (drafts). Default: `true`.

attributes.name: sticky-row-numbers
attributes.description: Keep the row-number column in place while scrolling horizontally. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: frozen-column-count
attributes.description: Freeze the first N columns while scrolling horizontally (counted after the reorder by `column.isFrozen`). Default: `0`.

attributes.name: show-row-toolbar
attributes.description: Show the row toolbar (`rowToolbar` entries) next to the hovered / focused row. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: toolbar-vertical-align
attributes.description:
Vertical alignment of the row toolbar in the `left` / `right` positions. Default: `bottom`.

- `top` — aligned to the row top (extends upwards)
- `center` — centered on the row
- `bottom` — aligned to the row bottom (extends downwards)

attributes.name: toolbar-horizontal-align
attributes.description:
Horizontal alignment of the row toolbar in the `top` position. Default: `center`.

- `start` — at the start of the row / `toolbarColumn`
- `center` — centered
- `end` — at the end
- `cursor` — at the pointer position

attributes.name: toolbar-trigger
attributes.description:
How the row toolbar opens. Default: `hover`.

- `hover` — on row hover
- `click` — on a click in the row
- `button` — from a trigger button in the row

attributes.name: toolbar-position
attributes.description:
Preferred position of the row toolbar. Default: `auto`.

- `auto` — the side with room
- `left` — left of the row
- `right` — right of the row
- `top` — above the row (see `toolbarHorizontalAlign`, `toolbarColumn`)
- `inline` — inside the row

attributes.name: toolbar-follow-cursor
attributes.description: The row toolbar follows the pointer horizontally. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: cell-toolbar-offset
attributes.description: Horizontal offset of the cell toolbar: a number 0–1 is a fraction of the cell width, a string any CSS length (`2rem`). Default: `0.2`.

attributes.name: context-menu-x-offset
attributes.description: Horizontal offset (px) of the context menu from the click point. Default: `8`.

attributes.name: context-menu-y-offset
attributes.description: Vertical offset (px) of the context menu from the click point. Default: `0`.

attributes.name: show-shortcuts-help
attributes.description: Show the keyboard-shortcuts help icon. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: shortcuts-help-position
attributes.description:
Corner of the keyboard-shortcuts help icon. Default: `top-right`.

- `top-right` — top right corner
- `top-left` — top left corner

attributes.name: column-min-width
attributes.description: Default `min-width` of every column without its own `minWidth` — a CSS length; a number means pixels. Unset = none.

attributes.name: allow-column-reorder
attributes.description: Let the user drag headers to reorder columns. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: sort-mode
attributes.description:
Header-click sorting. Default: `none`.

- `none` — sorting off
- `single` — one sorted column at a time
- `multiple` — several sorted columns (Ctrl+click adds a column)

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: Key of the persisted column state (widths / order the user arranged; core SPEC §12.17). Unset / empty = off; set = localStorage `km-state:web-grid:<key>`, or `loadStateCallback` / `saveStateCallback`.

attributes.name: persist-column-widths
attributes.description: Persist the column widths the user resized to (needs `storage-key`).

attributes.name: persist-column-order
attributes.description: Persist the column order the user dragged to (needs `storage-key`).

attributes.name: summary-position
attributes.description:
Where the summary bar (`renderSummaryCallback`) sits: one area or several `|`-separated ones, like `paginationPosition`. Unset = no summary.

- `top-left` — above the table, left
- `top-center` — above the table, centered
- `top-right` — above the table, right
- `bottom-left` — below the table, left
- `bottom-center` — below the table, centered
- `bottom-right` — below the table, right

attributes.name: summary-inline
attributes.description: The summary shares one line with the pager when both sit in the same area. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: enable-virtual-scroll
attributes.description: Render only the visible rows (give the grid a capped height). Default: `false`.

attributes.name: virtual-scroll-threshold
attributes.description: Row count from which the engine's automatic virtual scroll turns on. Default: `100`.

attributes.name: virtual-scroll-item-height
attributes.description: Fixed row height (px) virtual scroll computes with. Default: `38`.

attributes.name: virtual-scroll-overscan
attributes.description: Extra rows rendered above / below the viewport in virtual scroll. Default: `10`.

attributes.name: enable-infinite-scroll
attributes.description: Ask for more rows (`data-request`, `trigger: load-more`) when scrolled near the end, until `hasMoreItems` is `false`. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: infinite-scroll-threshold
attributes.description: Distance (px) from the bottom that triggers the next infinite-scroll load. Default: `100`.

attributes.name: enable-new-row
attributes.description: Experimental: an always-present empty row for entering a new record. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: new-row-position
attributes.description:
Experimental: where the empty new row sits. Default: `bottom`.

- `top` — above the data rows
- `bottom` — below the data rows

attributes.name: new-row-indicator
attributes.description: Experimental: text shown in the row-number cell of the empty new row. Default: `+`.

attributes.name: tree-data-sorted
attributes.description: Tree data: trust the order of `items` (the grid never re-sorts — pair with `data-request` for sort changes); `false` sorts siblings depth-first. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: tree-double-click-behavior
attributes.description:
What a double-click on a tree-column cell does. Default: `none`.

- `none` — nothing tree-specific (editing may start)
- `toggle` — expands / collapses the row

attributes.name: tree-expanded-glyph
attributes.description: HTML / text of the chevron of an expanded tree row. Equal to `treeCollapsedGlyph` → CSS rotates the glyph; different → the glyph is swapped. Default: `▶`.

attributes.name: tree-collapsed-glyph
attributes.description: HTML / text of the chevron of a collapsed tree row. Default: `▶`.

attributes.name: copy-with-headers
attributes.description: Copying a cell range also copies the column headers. Default: `false`.

attributes.name: paste-mode
attributes.description:
How a multi-cell paste treats cells that are not editable. Default: `skip-non-editable`.

- `skip-non-editable` — skips them, pastes the rest
- `all-columns` — pastes into them anyway
- `editable-only` — refuses them (reported as skipped and invalid)

attributes.name: validate-on-paste
attributes.description: Run `validateCallback` on every pasted cell. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: fill-direction
attributes.description:
Fill-handle drag direction for the whole grid; a column’s own `fillDirection` wins. Default: `vertical`.

- `vertical` — fills the source column only
- `all` — also fills across columns

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: UI strings (i18n) — a partial object (JSON attribute `labels`) merged per key over the English defaults: `noData`, `noResults`, `loading`, pager / go-to-row / menu texts, …. Reads back what was assigned.

attributes.name: custom-styles
attributes.description: CSS injected into the grid's shadow root (after the page-wide `window.components['web-grid'].customStyles`); an `@import`ed font is also linked in the document head.

attributes.name: tooltip-show-delay
attributes.description: Delay (ms) before a cell tooltip shows. Default: `200`.

attributes.name: tooltip-hide-delay
attributes.description: Delay (ms) before a cell tooltip hides. Default: `100`.

attributes.name: overlay-group
attributes.description: Scope the "one overlay open at a time" coordination to a named group. Overlays (the cell dropdown, the row toolbar with a click / button trigger, multiselects, datepickers, external popovers) sharing a group dismiss each other when one opens; different groups are independent. Unset = the default (ungrouped) group.

attributes.name: defer
attributes.description: Hold the first build (core, SPEC §6.3): while set when the element first connects, nothing is built and every input, callback and listener assigned meanwhile accumulates; `release()` (or removing the attribute) then builds once. Latched after the first build.

attributes.name: theme-source
attributes.description: Where this element reads its theme from instead of the page (core, SPEC §12.10): a CSS selector (nearest matching ancestor, else the first match), `'closest'` (the nearest ancestor carrying a theme signal), or (property only) an `Element`. Unset = the page.

attributes.name: motion
attributes.description: Motion level (core, SPEC §12.16): `auto` (default — inherit: the nearest `data-motion` ancestor (a section), else the page level `window.components.motion` / `<html data-motion>`; closest wins), `none` (no transitions, instant scrolling), `snappy` (short) or `smooth` (longer). Sets the shared `--base-duration-*` / `--base-scroll-behavior` tokens on the element through `data-motion`; the OS reduced-motion setting always wins.

attributes.name: responsive
attributes.description: Instance responsive rules (core, SPEC §6.7): partial configs on two axes — `device` (keyed by device class `mobile` / `tablet` / `desktop`; a mouse device is `desktop` at any width) and `breakpoint` (keyed by the window-width bucket); the breakpoint entry applies first, the device entry over it (device wins). An object or a JSON attribute, e.g. `{"device":{"tablet":{"presentation":"modal"}},"breakpoint":{"mobile":{…}}}`. Beats page rules (`window.components.responsive*`) and values set on the element; never reflects. An entry of `null` ignores the page rules while it matches.

events.name: row-change
events.description: A cell value was committed (editor, checkbox, paste, new row). `detail`: `{ row, draftRow, rowIndex, field, oldValue, newValue, isValid, validationError }`. Twin: `onRowChange(detail)`.

events.name: cell-edit-start
events.description: A cell editor opened. `detail`: `{ row, rowIndex, field }`. Twin: `onCellEditStart(detail)`.

events.name: cell-edit-cancel
events.description: A cell edit was cancelled. `detail`: `{ row, rowIndex, field }`. Twin: `onCellEditCancel(detail)`.

events.name: validation-error
events.description: `validateCallback` rejected a value. `detail`: `{ row, rowIndex, field, error, source: "edit" | "paste" }`. Twin: `onValidationError(detail)`.

events.name: focus-change
events.description: The focused row changed. `detail`: `{ row, rowIndex, oldRowIndex }`. Twin: `onFocusChange(detail)`.

events.name: row-delete
events.description: The `delete` built-in removed rows (cell menu / row toolbar / Ctrl+Delete) — after the fact; veto it with `beforeActionCallback`. Programmatic `removeRows` / `removeRow` do not fire it. `detail`: `{ rows, rowIndices }` (indices before the removal). Twin: `onRowDelete(detail)`.

events.name: cell-selection-change
events.description: The selected cell range changed (once per gesture / API call, only on a real change). `detail`: `{ range, cellCount, fields, rows }` — `range.startColIndex` / `endColIndex` are on-screen (visual) positions, not `columns` indices; `fields` = the range’s columns in on-screen order; `rows` = the row objects in the range. Cleared: `{ range: null, cellCount: 0, fields: [], rows: [] }`. Twin: `onCellSelectionChange(detail)`.

events.name: row-selection-change
events.description: The row selection changed (row-number click / Ctrl / Shift / drag, `selectRow` / `selectRowRange` / `clearSelection`, or cleared by another selection) — once per gesture / API call, only on a real change. `detail`: `{ rows, rowIndices }` (display order). Twin: `onRowSelectionChange(detail)`.

events.name: column-selection-change
events.description: The column selection changed (header click / Ctrl / Shift / drag, `selectColumn` / `selectColumnRange` / `clearColumnSelection`, or cleared by another selection) — once per gesture / API call, only on a real change. `detail`: `{ fields }` (on-screen order). Twin: `onColumnSelectionChange(detail)`.

events.name: data-request
events.description: Sort / page / page size changed or more rows are needed (server-side data). `detail`: `{ sort, page, pageSize, trigger, mode, skip }`. Twin: `onDataRequest(detail)`.

events.name: filter-change
events.description: A column filter changed. `detail`: `{ filters }`. With `filter-mode="server"` the consumer filters. Twin: `onFilterChange(detail)`.

events.name: column-resize
events.description: A column was resized. `detail`: `{ field, oldWidth, newWidth, allWidths }`. Twin: `onColumnResize(detail)`.

events.name: column-reorder
events.description: A column was moved. `detail`: `{ field, fromIndex, toIndex, allOrder }`. Twin: `onColumnReorder(detail)`.

events.name: row-expand
events.description: A tree row was expanded (chevron, keyboard, double-click, `toggleRowExpanded`, `expandRows`; NOT `expandAll` — that fires only `expanded-change`). `detail`: `{ row, path }`. Twin: `onRowExpand(detail)`.

events.name: row-collapse
events.description: A tree row was collapsed (chevron, keyboard, `toggleRowExpanded`, `collapseRows`; NOT `collapseAll`). `detail`: `{ row, path }`. Twin: `onRowCollapse(detail)`.

events.name: expanded-change
events.description: The expanded set changed (any expand / collapse, incl. `expandAll` / `collapseAll`) — one event per change, after the row events. `detail`: `{ paths }` = every expanded path (same as `expandedPaths`). Twin: `onExpandedChange(detail)`.

events.name: row-lock-change
events.description: A row was locked / unlocked by id. `detail`: `{ rowId, row, rowIndex, lockInfo, source }`. Twin: `onRowLockChange(detail)`.

events.name: cell-paste
events.description: A multi-cell paste finished. `detail`: `{ totalCells, successfulCells, failedCells, skippedCells, newRowsCreated, cellResults, hadHeaders }`. Twin: `onCellPaste(detail)`.

events.name: action
events.description: A toolbar / menu / shortcut item was activated. `detail`: `action` (built-in name or `custom`), `id`, `item`, `source` (`row-toolbar` | `cell-toolbar` | `context-menu` | `header-menu` | `keyboard`), `sourceEvent`, `triggerElement`, `dataset`, plus the surface fields (`row` / `rowIndex` / `column` / `field` / `value`, header-menu fields, or range `rows` / `rowIndices`). Fires after the item’s `onClick` and the built-in — a notification after the fact (after `delete` the row is already gone from `items`, after `add` the new row is present, after `move-*` the new order is in place); a throwing built-in is logged and the event still fires. Cancel with `beforeActionCallback`. Twin: `onAction(detail)`.

events.name: ready
events.description: Fired once after the first live build (core, SPEC §6.3), on the microtask after it; also the `ready` attribute, `:state(ready)`, `isReady` and `whenReady()`. Twin callback `onReady`.

events.name: input-rejected
events.description: Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.
